one_liner: Turn your phone or tablet into a huge, bright digital clock you can read from across the room.
description: Digital Clock - Huge LED Clock is a big, full-screen digital clock for the nightstand, desk, kitchen or office. Users pick colour, font and brightness, switch between digital and analog styles, use a dim night mode for the bedside, add a home-screen clock widget, and use the built-in big timer, countdown timer and stopwatch. Date, weather and battery can sit on the clock screen, and burn-in protection is included.
key_features: Huge full-screen digital clock readable from far away
Bright LED clock styles with colour, font and brightness control
Dim night mode for a glare-free bedside clock
Big timer, countdown timer and stopwatch
Date, weather and battery on the clock screen
usp: Turns any phone or tablet, even an old one, into a big bedside or desk clock that is easy to read at a glance.
target_audience: Adults in the US, UK, Canada and Australia who want an easy-to-read bedside, desk or kitchen clock, people with an old phone or tablet lying around, and anyone who wants a night clock that is not glaring
research_focus: how people use a big digital clock on a phone or tablet as a bedside night clock, desk clock or kitchen clock
reusing an old phone or tablet as a bedside clock, smart display or always-on clock
frustrations with bright, glaring phone screens and small hard-to-read clocks at night, and dim night mode setups
customising a clock screen: colours, fonts, widgets, burn-in protection and full-screen clock apps
timers, stopwatch and countdown on a clock display for study, workouts, cooking and focus
